title: Medieval Town time-lapse in Valdmark | Godot / GPT 6 / Fable 5.2
author: 2nd_breakfastt
selftext:
Hey guys! Finally somewhat happy with how this timelapse of a town being built in my game came out!

Check out the demo https://ynotved.itch.io/valdmark

VALDMARK is a medieval sandbox RPG inspired by games like Rimworld and Kenshi. This only showcases one of the many different ways you can choose to live your life in the game. Become a merchant, a leader of a mercenary company, a lone wanderer in the wilderness, a shop owner in a bustling city, the commander of a lords army, join a guild or cult and climb the ranks, and many many more things to explore and figure out in the game. Do them yourself, or hire members of your party to accomplish them for you

My goal is to make every play style a fun and viable way to live your life in Valdmark. And if your character dies… continue the legacy with their heir or companion. A different life and story is the goal for each play through 

More info on game mechanics, stating lives, and ways to play the game on the itch page

How I used AI: I used GPT-6 for brainstorming, game design, planning mechanics, and creating art references. Claude Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.2 handled the coding, implementing gameplay systems, and procedurally generating the artwork. The game itself is built in Godot, with Blender used to generate 3D models and assets.
